citation: Welch AA, Farahani RA, Egan AM, et al. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor blockade impairs islet secretion and glucose metabolism in humans. The Journal of Clinical Investigation. 2023.
protocol: Hyperglycaemic clamp with [3-3H]glucose tracer, saline vs exendin 9-39 (GLP-1 receptor blocker) infusion on two occasions in random order
population: n=12 without diabetes (BMI ~32, matched) and n=11 with type 2 diabetes
note: Use the saline day for the hyperglycaemic clamp; the exendin 9-39 day is a pharmacological arm to ignore. Tables in the XML are images (Table 1 has no rows), so numbers come from the text only; most time courses are figures. Non-diabetic participants are obese.
